s1.activation: automatic at full SP, unlimited duration

s2.startup: bounded serial Start_Attack completion plus Skill_2_Begin completion

s3.destination: four forward tiles, lowered to first HIGH boundary when emitted from LOW

verificationLimits: Native Unity/C# execution, particles, audio and frame parity are not recovered; original clip events, native graphs and source facings are retained.

Native S2 composite dispatch includes an eventless Skill_2_Begin action. The bounded local startup is the serial completion of Start_Attack and Skill_2_Begin; the flash ability uses its original absolute .233 predelay. No-target composite failure and sub-frame interrupt ordering remain unverified.

Normal/S1 first-only Begin state resets on lost legal input/control/skill switch in the local FSM. Native cooldown/end-state reentry ordering and maxAnimScale versus animation-controller priority are unrecovered.

Native S2 countEvent4 and source buff copying at projectile birth are not executable-recovered. Local ammo is spent at release; born S2 shots retain their selected stunned-target ATK scale but check victim stun at impact. Manual finish/retirement does not cancel born unmanaged shots.

Native S3 parabolic wall/death-area collision and stop-action dispatch are not executable-recovered. The local cardinal four-tile path stops at the first higher tile boundary from LOW or map/death-area boundary, using authored height/pass data. Collider circle1.2 uses shared point/huge bodies; blast uses selected range_radius and current impact occupancy.

S3 local collision applies one physical lane hit then the shared directional push; stop blast follows at the endpoint and may hit those enemies again. Native overlap ordering, hit_wall_flag write timing and push-motion frame parity remain unverified.

Native card cost integer composition is unrecovered; selected first-deployment addition is applied after the shared ordinary/potential/redeployment cost. The deployment flash makes one release-time target attempt; native no-target deployment retry behavior remains unverified.
